hardware.scope: Shared host, no exclusive CPU isolation; ORT limited2threads/nice15.

tokenizer-control.scope: Fixed queries and first128public source rows; not exhaustive tokenizer equivalence.

representation-control.scope: Small representation sanity control; not full FP32 quality or exhaustive equivalence.

fp32-control.scope: Fixed public pairs and synthetic orientation check. Author FP32 uses basic graph optimization without memory arena. This is not full-corpus FP32 quality or exhaustive conversion equivalence.

int8-control.scope: Fixed public pairs and synthetic orientation check. Author FP32 uses basic graph optimization without memory arena. This is not full-corpus FP32 quality or exhaustive conversion equivalence.

pilot.scope: Pretokenized query-by-query CPU replay; not online end-to-end latency.

full.scope: Pretokenized query-by-query CPU replay; not online end-to-end latency.

primary_model_usage.scope: Local cross-encoder pairs/forwards, not generated tokens or a provider bill. Pilot8 scores reused; full adds1992. Warmups/control inputs count separately.

setup_retries.description: Initial direct public-Hub TLS errors and PyPI wheel timeout; HTTPS mirrors used with pinned artifact hashes. Waiting scheduler restarted before any model inference to serialize representation control.
setup_retries.scope: Failed setup network timing was not fully instrumented; successful download durations do not equal total setup wall time.

decision.scope: Predeclared public-dev/resource decision only; business validation absent.

scope: One fixed public-dev model experiment. No original text/token IDs/credentials or production runtime paths published. No production dependency change or deployment.

metadata_projection_repair.change: Restore original category/evidence_groups using shared frozen-label projection. No metric/location/model-input/score changed.

input_reconstruction.scope: Reconstructed every canonical input digest; no embedding/model/SQL calls.
